parsed.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large, well-lit warehouse interior with high ceilings and concrete floors. Tall metal racks line both sides, filled with pallets of goods. Forklifts and workers are visible in the distance. Yellow safety barriers separate aisles from racks. Overhead signs indicate aisle numbers.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: An orange and gray forklift is parked on the left side of the aisle near a wall. It has a vertical mast and is positioned close to a yellow safety barrier. The forklift's forks are down, and it appears stationary. No operator is visible.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: Tall black metal racks extend vertically along the right side of the aisle, marked with yellow numbers like '13'. They hold stacked pallets of various items, including red crates and wrapped boxes. Yellow protective barriers are at their base.

objects.label: worker
objects.observation: A person wearing a red shirt is walking in the middle distance, slightly to the right of center. They appear to be moving toward the camera, carrying something in their hand. Their exact activity is unclear due to distance.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: Yellow plastic or metal barriers are installed along the floor at the base of the racks on the right side. They run parallel to the aisles and are spaced apart. Some are partially obscured by racks or other objects.

objects.label: aisle sign
objects.observation: White signs with black numbers '2' and '3' are mounted on the ceiling above the left aisle. They indicate aisle numbers. The signs are attached to the ceiling structure and are clearly visible against the background.
